name: sample_hazard_at_assets
description: Sample climate, hazard, or risk values at asset locations such as hospitals, schools, ports, roads, power plants, substations, or other infrastructure points.

hazard_artifact.description: Required hazard, climate, or risk layer artifact containing polygon GeoJSON features and a numeric value column.

assets_artifact.description: Optional asset layer artifact containing GeoJSON point features. Use this when assets have already been loaded.

assets_path.description: Optional path to an asset GeoJSON file. Relative paths are resolved from data/assets/.

value_column.description: Numeric hazard column to sample. If omitted, the function uses the value_column metadata from the hazard artifact.

asset_name_column.description: Optional column containing asset names. If omitted, the function tries common names like asset_name, name, facility_name, school_name, hospital_name, port_name, or substation_name.

asset_id_column.description: Optional column containing stable asset IDs. If omitted, the function tries common names like asset_id, id, facility_id, school_id, hospital_id, port_id, substation_id, or osm_id.

asset_type_column.description: Optional column containing asset type/category. If omitted, the function tries common names like asset_type, type, category, sector, or class.

sampling_method.description: Sampling method. Supported values: within, intersects, nearest. Usually use within for point assets inside hazard polygons.

include_unmatched_assets.description: If true, keep assets that do not match any hazard feature. If false, drop unmatched assets.

nearest_if_unmatched.description: If true, assets that do not match by within/intersects are assigned the nearest hazard feature.

max_nearest_distance_m.description: Optional maximum nearest-neighbor distance in meters when using nearest sampling or nearest_if_unmatched.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

input_hazard_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the hazard layer.

input_hazard_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the hazard layer.

input_assets_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the asset layer, if provided as an artifact.

input_assets_layer_id.description: Asset layer ID or asset file path.

layer_id.description: Generated layer ID for the asset-hazard sample output.

variable.description: Climate, hazard, or risk variable sampled.

source_variable.description: Original source variable, if different from the derived variable.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing asset features with sampled hazard values.

matched_asset_count.description: Number of assets matched to a hazard feature.

unmatched_asset_count.description: Number of assets not matched to a hazard feature.

valid_sample_count.description: Number of assets with valid sampled hazard values.

missing_sample_count.description: Number of assets with missing sampled hazard values.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

summary.description: Summary statistics for sampled asset values.

table.description: Table-friendly sampled asset output with asset name, ID, type, sampled value, and coordinates.

provenance.description: Information about sampling method, hazard layer, and asset source.
